author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Launch Overview Video for World of Warcraft: Forever, an MMO RPG developed by Blizzard Entertainment. Players can get a thorough overview of what the game has to offer, including over 1000 new quests to take on, updates to classes and specializations, new and reimagined zones, and so much more. Dive into World of Warcraft: Forever, launching on November 4 for PC.
title: World of Warcraft: Forever - Official Launch Overview

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Release Date Trailer for Dispatch, a comedic superhero narrative adventure game developed by AdHoc Studio. Players will dispatch the right villain-turned-hero for a variety of emergencies around the city, across a dark yet hopeful narrative. Dispatch is launching on December 9 for iOS and Android, with the game being available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
title: Dispatch - Official Mobile Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Release Date Trailer for Grave Mistakes, an action online co-op game developed by Happy Volcano. Players will gather with friends to run the operations of the Good Mourning Funeral Home to prepare bodies for their funerals, ensure final words are stated with respect, and dinner is sorted through the limbs of the dead. Grave Mistakes is launching on November 26 for PC (Steam).
title: Grave Mistakes - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Announcement Trailer for Guild Wars Afterlife, an upcoming DLC expansion to the hit fantasy MMO RPG developed by ArenaNet. Players will be taken to the land of Xotecha in the upcoming expansion to take on the forces of the Cult of Odran. Meet new allies, fight through an ever-changing dungeon, and seek new rewards ripe for the taking. Guild Wars Afterlife is launching on January 13, 2027, for iOS, Android, and PC (Steam).
title: Guild Wars Afterlife - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Alone in the arena. Endless waves. Endless Strategies. Endless Madness. description: Take a look at the Voyage to Early Access 2: From Creatures to Chassis Video for Subnautica 2, an underwater survival adventure game developed by Unknown Worlds Entertainment. Players can get a deeper look at the process of bringing the various creatures to life and ensuring their realistic behaviors for players to discover. Discover new creatures in the content update launching in December 2026 for Subnautica 2, available now in Early Access for Xbox Series X|S and PC (Steam).
title: Subnautica 2 - Official Voyage to Early Access 2: From Creatures to Chassis Video

author: GameTrailers
description:
Silica leaves Early Access, and version 1.0 is available now on PC. Check out the Silica version 1.0 launch trailer for this sci-fi game that combines real-time strategy and first-person shooter gameplay in a war for control of the desert planet Baltarus. Version 1.0 of Silica features a new story-driven campaign, expanded tactical options, and improvements to multiplayer. 

On the distant planet of Baltarus, two rival human factions, Sol and Centauri, compete for control of valuable resources, only to find themselves facing resistance from the planet's native alien inhabitants. What begins as a struggle between human forces becomes a three-sided war, with each faction bringing its own units, technology, and approach to combat.
title: Silica - Official Version 1.0 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the 1st Anniversary Broadcast Recap Trailer for Where Winds Meet, the hit open-world action RPG developed by Everstone Games. Players will get a look at the upcoming updates and additions to the game to celebrate a full year of Where Winds Meet. Access the Hutuo Update for Where Winds Meet on November 13 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), iOS, Android, and PC (Steam).
title: Where Winds Meet - Official 1st Anniversary Broadcast Recap Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the latest Age of Wonders 4 trailer to see what to expect from The Silver Seas expansion, which brings expanded ocean gameplay, two new forms, new Mercantile culture, and more to the strategy game. The Silver Seas expansion for Age of Wonders 4 is out now, and it is included in Expansion Pass 4 alongside two more expansions which will be available in 2027. 

Age of Wonders 4: The Silver Seas adds a new culture focused around sailing, trade, and secrets, along with new aquatic physical forms and tomes of new spells for land and sea alike. Explore oceans rich with mystery, master the tides to claim their hidden treasures, and become the undisputed ruler of the waves.

The Silver Seas expansion centers around the new Mercantile culture, built on turning every deal, alliance, and rivalry into profit. Place cities on both land and sea, and expand your influence. Venture and discover new world map content, including a pirate dwelling with a variety of possible captains at the helm, ea
title: Age of Wonders 4: The Silver Seas - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
It's time to explore Central Park. Check out the launch trailer for The Division 2: Echoes of Central Park, and head to New York's iconic landmark in this expansion for the shooter RPG. The Division 2: Echoes of Central Park expansion is available now.

In The Division 2, save your country in Washington, DC. In the Warlords of New York expansion, hunt down Aaron Keener, a former Agent who has taken control of New York. In Battle for Brooklyn, defend the borough as the Cleaners cross the river. And in Echoes of Central Park, answer a distress signal from deep within the park and face a new threat.
title: The Division 2: Echoes of Central Park - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Argent Flow Operator Combat Demo Trailer for Arknights: Endfield, the hit action RPG developed by Hypergryph. Players can get a look at Argent Flow in action with his Dust Resplendent basic attack, Stars Shifted combo skill, and his devastating Heavens Sundered ultimate. Fight as Argent Flow in Arknights: Endfield on November 5 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), iOS, Android, and PC (Steam).
title: Arknights: Endfield - Official Argent Flow Operator Combat Demo Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Longtime Bethesda Game Studios director Todd Howard celebrates the developer's 40th anniversary by looking back at the games it's built over its four decades, from the big ones you definitely remember (The Elder Scrolls, Fallout, Starfield) to the smaller ones you might not (Gridiron, The Terminator). Stay tuned to the final minute of the video, where Howard reveals the full name and logo for The Elder Scrolls 6, being The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel.
title: Bethesda Game Studios: Official 40th Anniversary Update (feat. Todd Howard)

author: GameTrailers
description:
Todd Howard, longtime director of The Elder Scrolls and Fallout franchises at Bethesda Game Studios, announces the official subtitle for The Elder Scrolls 6 and reveals its logo as the developer marks its 40th anniversary. The full title of the next Elder Scrolls game is The Elder Scrolls VI: Sentinel.

#IGN #ElderScrolls6
title: The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel – Official Title and Logo Reveal
